name: RC-B10-0568/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the military takeover in Guinea-Bissau on 26 November 2025, which stopped the election results from being announced. It asks for the constitutional order and the electoral process to be restored immediately. It demands the release of arrested opposition leaders and an independent investigation into human rights abuses. It also asks the European Union to review its agreements and funding so that money does not support the military junta, and asks the Council to consider sanctions on those responsible.

- The European Union is asked to review its agreements and funding with Guinea-Bissau.
- The Council is asked to consider sanctions on those behind the coup and rights abuses.
- The junta is asked to release detained opposition leaders and publish verified election results.
